title: Count box layouts that exactly fill a shelf
insight: LeetCode 70 Climbing Stairs: Fibonacci recurrence computed iteratively in O(n)
prompt: The warehouse planner wants to know how many distinct ways a shelf can be filled with our 1-unit and 2-unit boxes. Implement Layouts in layouts.go as specified in README.md, keep package shelving and the exported signature as they are, use only the standard library, and confirm that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass.
